reviewed.startup: Catalog and preference reads are asynchronous. Windows graphics choice and shader warm-up add work before first UI. Bootstrap timings cover app.main, not whole-process TTI.
reviewed.rendering: Shared row RepaintBoundary isolates hover. Existing detail blur and wallpaper boundaries are used. Offstage branches keep scroll/state, mute tickers, exclude focus/input/semantics.
reviewed.images: Book artwork shares full asset cache across small and large views. Wallpaper ResizeImage is bounded at 1920x1440. No speculative per-size caches or cover quality reduction added.
reviewed.timers: Hidden lobby elapsed-time timer now stops. Rating feed already observes visibility/lifecycle. Message summary polling every 30 seconds is foreground/account gated. Connection deadlines and backoff are bounded.
reviewed.network: Lobby/room WebSockets preserve presence/membership across page changes. Request generations reject stale responses. This round does not alter server protocols or disconnect background membership.
reviewed.local_files: ZIP compression, decompression and checkpoint statistics already use workers. File copy is asynchronous and progress is integer-percent throttled. Large cloud hash/byte comparison now uses a worker.
reviewed.api_decode: Account JSON decode is synchronous after bounded asynchronous response reads. Large authenticated response parsing needs real-account payload profiling before changing ownership or caching.
reviewed.webview: Production account pages use the shared Windows WebView2 environment. Controllers follow page lifetime; the environment and browser cache may outlive a page. Browser process memory must be counted separately.
reviewed.native_game: Current native game execution is a placeholder. Game frame time, audio, downloads/runtime memory are outside this launcher measurement.
reviewed.observability: Windows main-thread message sample: 10518 WM_GETOBJECT vs 84 WM_NULL in 10 seconds. Foreground CPU around 0.29-0.40 core under this host. A low sample after inspection disconnect did not preserve verified focus. Exact query client is unconfirmed; kernel and UIA ETW recording require unavailable privileges. Accessibility remains enabled.
